effects.text: The salt sits in the yard and the city goes without. And this wind. Look at it. Even the weather's in on it.

phases.journal: The salt has come through the Waste. In the city somebody buys every robbed sack: who answers for it?

effects.text: The wagons got through. Now somebody in the city can answer for the empty ones. Hear that wind? Even the sky wants a name.

quests.title: Brackish Wells
quests.summary: Salt carts out of the Saltpan come home light. Find out who robs them on the brine flats.

offer.ask: Your cart's come back empty, carter.
offer.say: #greet#, #address#. Three carts left the Saltpan and three came home light. They take the salt and never the oxen. Ask the sack-counter what goes missing, ask the raker who worked in the city, then walk the brine flats after dark. #oath#.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. A tally of sacks, and a grey paw-mark at its foot. Somebody counts my salt before I've loaded it. When the next wagon loads, ride with me.
